minutes. Audio, drafts and speaker state rema"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"in separate for each meeting."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Select a DSH session to record, or ask the DSH agent to import an absolute local

workspaces."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The compact recorder shows the active capture controls:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Expand it to view elapsed time, track states and the live transcript draft:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"For imported audio or after recording, reference a meeting to summarize its
